facts.business: Meera Industries Limited manufactures textile machinery, including ring spinning frames, doubling frames, and winding machines, serving the global textile industry.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital work-in-progress capitalised during the year

guidance_or_targets.statement: To fill the new capacity and restore operating margin to double digits
To grow the technical-textile and export mix, where realisations and stickiness are both better
To continue reducing debt and working capital
To keep engineering, not discounting, as the basis on which we compete

key_risks: Warranty provisions on machinery sales (1-year warranty) based on systematic method per Ind AS 37
Dependence on indigenous technology with no foreign collaboration
Lease obligations for factory and office premises (5-year terms, secured by lessor's title)
facts.related_party_note: Personal guarantees provided by promoters for CAPEX LC and Bank Guarantee; lease liabilities secured by lessor's title to leased assets.
